messages:
sam: spotting from logs: backup-worker in staging printed a full KMS resource path plus a truncated ciphertext header. not raw secret but sensitive.

Dina: paste snippet and which pod?

sam: redacted: 
```
WARN backup-worker: decrypt error projects/infra-42/locations/global/keyRings/staging-kr/cryptoKeys/backup-transit: ciphertext=Qm9...9cX
```

raju: that resource looks like it's using our external-HSM key. if the resource id leaked, we need to assume a targeted attacker could query metadata. plan: 1) prevent further logging, 2) snapshot audit logs, 3) temporary RBAC tighten, 4) rotate/reencrypt.

logger-bot: Created log-export job id exp-3990012345 -> gs://sec-staging/hold/3990012345/audit.tar.gz

oncall: Ack. exporting 72h of KMS/IAM/GCS logs.

Dina: quick RBAC command I'll apply (staging):
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding infra-42 \\\
  --member=serviceAccount:backup-worker@infra-42.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

raju: also add an IAM condition to block calls from the backup job namespace as a belt-and-suspenders.

vault-bot: Received rotate request for projects/infra-42/locations/global/keyRings/staging-kr/cryptoKeys/backup-transit. rotation queued. ref=rot-3990

Dina: pushing patch to redact KMS resource names in logs (commit 4b2f8a3). regex used: `s|(projects/[^\s]+/keyRings/[^\s]+/cryptoKeys/[^:\s]+)|<kms_redacted>|g`

raju: inventory shows ~11 backup objects referencing old header in gs://backups/staging/2026-03-25/. owners listed in metadata. we'll notify owners to run rewrap.

vault-bot: Rotation complete. new primary version: 7. audit path: gs://sec-staging/hold/3990012345/rotation.log

Dina: owners notified with 48h rewrap window; sample rewrap script attached in ticket INC-2026-0422-01.

raju: after rewrap window we'll rotate once more and then restore minimal roles. also scheduling a 30m blameless postmortem tomorrow.

sam: summary: detection -> logging patch -> RBAC tighten -> audit snapshot -> key rotation -> owner rewrap -> second rotation -> restore. INC-2026-0422-01 tracks follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
